nodes.label: Stacked Honebill logo
nodes.rationale: Black field. An orange bee-planet mark sits above the word: two short antennae, a rounded upper body, left and right wing loops, a lower lobe, and a black four-pointed star cut from the center. Under it, Honebill is set in an orange geometric outline face with hexagonal counters. The left stem of the H and the outer edge of the final l are clipped by the frame.

nodes.label: Honebill
nodes.rationale: Readable wordmark under the mark. The letters spell Honebill in an orange outline geometric face.
